5624.title: [M156] Update Skia Slug validation and direct-mask replay fixes
5624.body:
[M156] Update Skia Slug validation and direct-mask replay fixes (#5624)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/434
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5625
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/fdae549c4f686a6b608239334d17df0f57824db1...b4715bb4e58f70e832ba6e49e21cc3647c2b4145

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to native
merge b4715bb4e58f70e832ba6e49e21cc3647c2b4145 on release/4.156.x.
Record upstream chrome/m156 revision
bc965180c7f33af63bb59d94f06a9003279dd6fc while retaining milestone 156.

Adopt upstream validation of serialized Slug positions, matrices, bounds
and flags to prevent malformed direct-mask data from bypassing atlas
sampling constraints. Preserve creation-time float rounding during replay,
bound direct-mask offsets, and retain rendering fallbacks for unsuitable
glyph data. Include the accompanying Slug regressions and GPU test fixes.

Pin the actual two-parent native merge rather than the reviewed PR head.
Its tree, 79b0aed8c11f3c501d7bbd00e822862daed69503, matches reviewed
commit 6d3a94de4b7a09579d0875c2f48ff1e06866852c. The dependent repin
updates the gitlink and matching manifest SHA together, recording landed
ancestry without changing the reviewed native content.

The parent diff is limited to externals/skia and cgmanifest.json.
Managed wrappers, generated bindings and package versions remain
unchanged. The producing Linux x64 native source build, regeneration,
managed build and unfiltered console solution passed.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
5624.author: mattleibow

5617.title: [M156] Update Skia path, clip and glyph replay fixes
5617.body:
[M156] Update Skia path, clip and glyph replay fixes (#5617)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/432
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5621
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/92d87f74f704671936d3cf7f15249037e48e9823...fdae549c4f686a6b608239334d17df0f57824db1

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration to native
merge fdae549c4f686a6b608239334d17df0f57824db1 on release/4.156.x.
Record upstream chrome/m156 revision
01c8c057881f90924adfb2eddb05609151f3d66a while retaining milestone 156.

Adopt upstream corrections for Ganesh device-space path bounds and software
coverage-mask subset clamping, Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter
bounds, and Ganesh/Graphite Slug replay validation when glyph-atlas bilerp
is unavailable. Include the scaler-independent oversized-glyph regression
assertion so CoreText bounds need not match FreeType dimensions.

Pin the actual two-parent native merge rather than the reviewed PR head.
Its tree, 13169ff5ffd7d3506fc4dd9371af30fd6faa8936, matches reviewed
commit d85876724650d28454f0997cef90bff431d5457b, preserving reviewed
native content while recording the landed ancestry. The dependent repin
updates the gitlink and matching manifest SHA together.

The parent diff is limited to externals/skia and cgmanifest.json; managed
wrappers, generated bindings and package versions remain unchanged.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
